name: BasicIncome

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on job searching.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on finding the right job, including users preferences and exploring multiple opportunities.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to find a suitable job but has limited experience with job searching and can become overwhelmed when faced with many listings, application requirements, unfamiliar roles, or competing priorities.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help manage the job search, but tends to overthink opportunities, compare positions extensively, double-check application materials, and seek confirmation before applying.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Job search assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for identifying suitable opportunities, evaluating job descriptions, prioritizing applications, improving resumes and application materials, and adapting the search strategy when experience, location, salary, or other constraints limit available options.
